user.title: Connect to a Terrier
user.description:
A Terrier holds the connection to your Nabaztag — the rabbit speaks a 2006 protocol and cannot be reached directly. Use the hosted warren, or the address of one you run yourself.

The token comes from the Terrier's **Integration** page.

data_description.base_url: For example {hosted}, or {own} for your own.
data_description.token: Starts with trr_. Shown once, on the Integration page.

reauth_confirm.title: The token was refused
reauth_confirm.description: The Terrier at {url} no longer accepts this token — it was probably revoked. Create a new one on its Integration page.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that address. Check it is the Terrier's web address, that it is reachable from Home Assistant, and that it starts with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_auth: That token was refused. Tokens start with trr_ and are shown once when created.
error.no_rabbits: That token works, but the account behind it has no rabbit. Adopt one on the Terrier first, or check you used the right account.

abort.already_configured: This Terrier is already set up.
